newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas hires Publicis for World Cup team.
newsitem.headline: Adidas hires Publicis for World Cup team.

text.p: German sportswear maker Adidas AG said on Monday it has hired French advertising group Publicis as its partner for worldwide World Cup 1998 public relations.
Adidas said the international programme will continue through the 1998 World Cup in France and will be managed from Paris by Idees Dialogue Conseil, the public relations unit of Publicis.
Adidas has signed up to be an official sponsor and supplier of the World Cup.
